introduction: WOOKTOOL screwdriver sets support hardware, retail and private-label tool programs that require a clear size configuration, dependable shaft and tip specification, and market-ready packaging. Buyers can use this page to prepare a focused inquiry before sample review.

Customization may include handle color, logo position, shaft and tip configuration, color box, blister or display packaging, barcode and carton mark. The final assortment should reflect the expected application and sales channel in the destination market.
To request a quote, share the preferred set configuration, quantity, target market, brand artwork, package format and any reference sample or product standard.

faq.question: What sizes can be included in a screwdriver set?
faq.answer: This set is listed with 6 x 105mm, 6 x 130mm, 6 x 150mm and 8 x 200mm directions; confirm the required assortment and tip types in the RFQ.

faq.question: Can the screwdriver handles use a custom color and logo?
faq.answer: Yes. Handle color and logo position can be reviewed alongside the selected model and order quantity.

faq.question: What packaging works for retail screwdriver sets?
faq.answer: Custom color boxes are available, and other retail packaging, barcode and carton-mark requirements can be discussed during the quotation review.

faq.question: How are screwdriver sets checked before shipment?
faq.answer: Typical checks include shaft material and size, magnetic tip and reversible function, handle assembly, logo appearance, packing quantity and carton marks.

faq.question: Can this be quoted as a private-label tool set?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide your brand, target market, expected quantity and packaging brief for a private-label quote.
